notes: Cross-verse consistency with JOB.36.17. The same construction — `מָלֵא` governing a bare accusative of material with no preposition and no object marker on it — held the supplied *of* on the verb at 36.17 and on the noun at 36.16. Rule 44 governs: where the English predicate can reach a bare complement only through a preposition the ASV has written, that preposition joins the predicate's unit. Only the s017/s018 boundary moves.
